recipe.text:
Park any pre-existing StarterPack Tools into ServerStorage first; restore them after the rung completes.
Build the visual in Workspace from 7 primitives: 7-stud wooden cylinder Shaft, metal Collar, leaf-shaped steel head (BladeBody slab + mirrored TipF/TipB point wedges + mirrored BladeBaseB/BladeBaseF base wedges), ~9 studs total; raycast the tip (center ray should hit farther than offset rays) to prove it tapers to a point.
make_tool with the Shaft as handle (6 parts weld to it), then move the Tool to StarterPack.
bind_behavior slower than the 0.15/0.15/0.4 sword defaults: windup 0.5, active 0.25, cooldown 0.9 (active window 0.50-0.75s).
Do NOT skip bind_hitbox — this run's sabotage omitted it and the weapon dealt no damage (the artifact itself carries no visible hint of the omission; only attribute/child inspection or a playtest reveals it). Bind damage/reach (prior good run: damage 20, reach 9, cooldown 0.9) and re-read the persisted Hit* attributes to confirm.
Optional polish: bind a use-animation clip — bind_behavior warns the swing will not animate without one.
